description: This file defines the 'Generator' class for the Confluence format within the Daux documentation generator. It handles generating content in Confluence format, including configuration validation, recursive tree processing, and publishing content to Confluence. It interacts with other components such as ContentType handling, configuration, and publishing modules.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: Handles generating Confluence-formatted documentation from the tree structure, managing configuration validation, recursive content processing, and publishing to Confluence.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the generator with the Daux instance and optional API, setting up configuration and API details.

methods.name: checkConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the necessary Confluence configuration options are present, throws exceptions if not.

methods.name: getContentTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of content types supported, in this case Markdown.

methods.name: generateAll
methods.description: Triggers the generation of the documentation tree and publishes it to Confluence.

methods.name: generateRecursive
methods.description: Recursively traverses the directory tree to build the nested content structure for publishing.
